practicum.title: Overview of the Company
practicum.description: STMicroelectronics’ Back-end Manufacturing & Technology plant in Calamba City, the Philippines, began operations in January 1999. The state-of-the-art facility forms part of ST’s strategic network of front- and back-end manufacturing sites that spans Europe and Asia, supplying high-volume silicon solutions to our customers globally. To provide its customers with an independent, secure, and cost-effective manufacturing machine, ST operates a worldwide network of front-end (wafer fabrication) and back-end (assembly, test, and packaging) plants. ST’s principal wafer fabs are located in Agrate Brianza and Catania (Italy), Crolles, Rousset and Tours (France), and in Singapore. The wafer fabs are complemented by world-class assembly-and-test facilities located in China, Malaysia, Malta, Morocco, the Philippines, and Singapore.

practicum.title: Nature of Tasks
practicum.description: During the internship, the student was deployed to the OPS1 Assembly Department, specifically in the Wirebond Area under Process Engineering section. The student was also given numerous tasks by the employees in the Wirebond process engineering section, helping the team by joining in weekly meetings, discussing the problems & proposed solutions, capturing pictures inside & outside the production line, printing necessary documents, presenting the project’s progress, and printed & laminated labels. Power BI monitoring yield tool is the primary project of the student followed by the student’s proposed project of creating an embedded website for the Power BI projects in the wirebond area. The project enables the Wirebond employees to have easier access to the reports, automated generation of charts for the purpose of their weekly presentation of yield and ppm (parts per million) monitoring, and continuous insights that explain the correlation of the devices, machines, brand model, wirebond line, package groups, interrupts per reason code, and ppm from time to time.

practicum.title: Total Hours Rendered
practicum.description: Throughout the OJT journey, the student completed a total of 324 hours in STMicroelectronics Inc., Backend Manufacturing & Technology plant in Calamba, Laguna. The student’s practicum engagement spans from April 22 to July 31, 2025, following a schedule of 8:00 AM up to 5:30 PM, 8.5 hours each day from Monday through Friday. During the first day in the STMicroelectronics Inc. Calamba, the student listened to the Company Orientation, followed by the Power BI Training and the 7 QC Tools Training. Moreover, the student went to the training room in order to complete various training presentations that are needed before being deployed to their respective departments. The student was deployed to the OPS1 Assembly Department, under Wirebond Process Engineering section. A Line tour was conducted to provide the students with the processes involved in the FOL (Front of Line) semiconductor manufacturing. The Power BI yield monitoring tool, which was discussed by the supervisor and the student, was developed and served as the student’s main project in the company. Additionally, the student proposed another project that these Power BI reports will be stored into the embedded website to create a central repository of the various Power BI reports, specifically for Wirebond process engineers.

practicum.title: Conclusion / Reflection
practicum.description: The practicum experience at STMicroelectronics Inc., Calamba BEMT plant has been a valuable part of the student’s academic and professional development. Over the course of three months, the student was given the opportunity to apply classroom knowledge in a real-world industrial setting, specifically within a globally recognized semiconductor manufacturing environment. This hands-on experience enabled the student to translate theoretical concepts into practical applications, addressing real operational needs of the Wirebond Department. In addition, the student’s enhanced understanding of data science principles, combined with expertise in full-stack web development and Power BI, has uniquely positioned him to bridge the gap between data processing and data presentation. The ability to create robust Power BI reports and translate raw data into intuitive, actionable dashboards demonstrates a comprehensive skill set that spans the entire data value chain, from backend data handling to frontend visualization. This integrated capability not only supports smarter decision-making but also addresses the growing demand for data-driven solutions in modern industries.
